## Debugging Next.js Output Directory Issue

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

Common problems:
- If the build script completes but there are fatal npm warnings (e.g. missing package files), the `.next` folder might not be created.
- If your deployment expects `out/` (static export), ensure you run `next export` and not just `next build`.
- If using custom server or output location, update your deployment configuration accordingly.v## Debugging Next.js Output Directory Issue

- If your deployment expects `out/` (static export), ensure you run `next export` and not just `next build`.
- If using custom server or output location, update your deployment configuration accordingly. ## Debugging Next.js Output Directory Issue

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.

- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.

- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.

- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.

- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.
- The `.next` folder should be present at the project root (`frontend_app/.next`) after a successful build.
- Check `next.config.js` for custom build/output directories.
- Make sure all file/directory paths referenced in the project exist.
- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

For CI/CD:
- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.

If you encounter the error "no output directory found" during deployment:
- Ensure `next build` completes without critical errors.

- Investigate npm/yarn install warnings – especially missing files in node modules used during build.
- See build log for errors relating to `@napi-rs/wasm-runtime` as these may affect some dependencies and output.

- Use `npx next build` (or `npm run build`) to generate the `.next` folder.
- Output is expected in `.next`, unless you use Next.js export mode or have specified a different output.
- If using `next export`, the output defaults to `out/`.
